troubleshooting.title: Browser Runs Out of Memory when Editing Large Files

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: My browser runs out of memory when working with large documents in .

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: When renders documents, the browser can use more memory than the original document size.

steps-informal.p: To work with large documents, an administrator can configure some elements as foldable. then automatically folds these elements in large documents to improve loading time. After the document loads, the elements progressively unfold.
steps-informal.note: The -oxy-foldable property does not work with elements that have: display: inline.
steps-informal.p: To test it, configure a custom framework that associates the CSS file to large XML documents.
